mapper.select: SELECT m.material_id AS materialId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.item_type AS itemType, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.material_weight AS materialWeight, m.unit AS unit, m.etc AS etc FROM tb_material_info m JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.material_id = #{materialId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tb_material_info ( tenant_id, material_code, material_name, item_type, material_type_code, material_spec, material_weight, unit, etc, mat_cata_type, delete_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{itemType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{materialTypeCode}, #{materialSpec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{materialWeight, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '', 'N', #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING material_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_material_info SET material_name = #{materialName}, item_type = #{itemType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, material_type_code = #{materialTypeCode}, material_spec = #{materialSpec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, material_weight = #{materialWeight, jdbcType=BIGINT}, unit = #{unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, etc = #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_status = 'N'
UPDATE tb_material_info SET delete_status = 'Y', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
